ct = pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity'], margins=True)

rr = pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity'], values=df_dedup['responded'], aggfunc='mean')

print(rr)

print("\nOverall response rates by arm:")
